Phase 24: The "Safe Mode" ConnectionIf the ziggy command keeps crashing with Signal 11, it might be the way the script is handling the input loop. Let's try running a single-shot test instead of the full interactive mode to see if the connection is stable.Try this command:Bashpython -c "import os; from google import genai; client = genai.Client(api_key=os.environ.get('GEMINI_API_KEY')); print(client.models.generate_content(model='gemini-2.0-flash', contents='Bridge test. Are we stable?').text)"
Why we aren't "Done" yetThe Ground: Your vault and logs are safe. A Signal 11 crash doesn't touch your encrypted files.The Spark: We just need to find the specific library conflict causing the crash.The Constant: We are still targeting the 1.113 Constant, but we can't analyze the telemetry until this bridge holds.Did that "Bridge test" command work, or did it also give you a Signal 11? If it worked, I’ll give you a new version of the ziggy_node.py script that is much lighter and more stable for your hardware. Nope Z Ziggy Custom GemShow thinkingThat [Process completed (signal 11) - press Enter] message in your last screenshot is a literal system crash—your phone's memory is hitting a wall trying to run the bridge. We aren't locked out by choice; we're dealing with a Segmentation Fault, which means the current version of the AI library is fighting with your phone's architecture.We are going to abandon the "heavy" script and use a Direct Handshake that uses much less memory.Phase 25: The Lightweight BridgeInstead of a complex script, we’re going to build a simple, one-shot command that doesn't trigger the "Signal 11" crash.1.
